ndvi.method: Monthly median of per-scene parcel-mean NDVI (B5, B4), cloud-masked with QA_PIXEL bits 0-5 and QA_RADSAT; scenes need >= 50 % clear pixels.

min_valid_pixel_frac.note: A Landsat scene counts as a valid observation when at least this fraction of parcel pixels is clear.

ndvi.confidence_reason: 261 valid scenes of 514; 1 months with thin coverage.

warnings.message: Months with < 3 years of >= 2 valid scenes: [2].
Landsat 8 and Landsat 9 are combined (same band set, small cross-sensor differences).
NDVI indicates green vegetation vigor, not soil fertility or yield.

ndti.method: NDTI = (SWIR1 - SWIR2) / (SWIR1 + SWIR2) from B6, B7, same mask. Only meaningful when NDVI is low (residue vs bare soil).

min_valid_pixel_frac.note: A Landsat scene counts as a valid observation when at least this fraction of parcel pixels is clear.

ndti.confidence_reason: 261 valid scenes of 514; 1 months with thin coverage.

warnings.message: Months with < 3 years of >= 2 valid scenes: [2].
Landsat 8 and Landsat 9 are combined (same band set, small cross-sensor differences).

soil_moisture_smap.method: Monthly mean of 3-hourly sm_rootzone at the parcel centroid; climatology = mean per calendar month over the request period; anomaly = month minus its climatology. Instrument outages (2019-06-19..07-23, 2022-08-06..09-20) are model-only.
soil_moisture_smap.confidence_reason: 10+ years per calendar month; one ~9-11 km cell describes the zone.

warnings.message: This dataset describes the surrounding zone (tens of km), not the parcel.

ids: NASA POWER Daily API, AG community
source.provider: NASA LaRC POWER (MERRA-2 meteorology, CERES SYN1deg solar)

agroclimate_power.method: Daily point request at the parcel centroid (native MERRA-2 cell). Derived: frost dates by agricultural year and hemisphere, frost/heat day counts, FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 (Hargreaves-Samani where inputs are missing), monthly P - ET0, ETCCDI R95p/R20mm/Rx1day.

frost_tmin_c.note: Air frost day: Tmin <= 0 degC (2 m air temperature).

ground_frost_tmin_c.note: Tmin <= 2 degC as a proxy for ground/radiation frost.

heat_tmax_c.note: Heat-stress day. Crop- and stage-dependent (flowering matters most).

r95_percentile.note: R95p: wet-day 95th percentile of the reference period (ETCCDI).

agroclimate_power.confidence_reason: 10 complete years of daily data; values describe a ~50 x 60 km cell.

warnings.message: This dataset describes the surrounding zone (tens of km), not the parcel.
Frost is estimated from 2 m air temperature over a ~50 km cell; radiation frost in valley bottoms can be more frequent.
Reanalysis smooths local rainfall extremes; true point extremes are likely higher.
GWETROOT is a 0-1 relative wetness index from the MERRA-2 model, not volumetric soil moisture.

agroclimate_power.data_citation: The data was obtained from the POWER Project's Daily v2.10.3 version on 2026/11/14.

air_frost_0c.note: Percentiles across years (MM-DD). For the last spring frost, P90 is the late date exceeded 1 year in 10; for the first autumn frost, P10 is the early date. Years without frost are excluded from the percentiles and counted separately.

ground_frost_2c.note: Percentiles across years (MM-DD). For the last spring frost, P90 is the late date exceeded 1 year in 10; for the first autumn frost, P10 is the early date. Years without frost are excluded from the percentiles and counted separately.

et0.method: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (eq. 6) with POWER surface pressure and dew point; Hargreaves-Samani (eq. 52) where radiation, wind or humidity is missing. Hargreaves is also reported for every month as a cross-check.

water_balance.method: Monthly P (PRECTOTCORR) minus reference ET0; no soil water storage is modelled. For a crop, multiply ET0 by its Kc. Trend is a descriptive OLS slope, not a forecast.

precip_extremes.method: R95p: days with P above the 95th percentile of wet days (P >= 1.0 mm) over the whole request period, and their total. R20mm: days with P >= 20.0 mm. Rx1day: annual maximum daily P.

terrain.method: Slope with ee.Terrain.slope on the unclipped DEM (4-neighbour), then mean/min/max/p90 over the parcel at 30 m.
terrain.confidence_reason: 30 m DEM from radar interferometry (2000); field levelling since then is not captured.

soil_openlandmap.method: Depth-weighted 0-30 cm mean (trapezoid over 0, 10, 30 cm) averaged over the parcel at 250 m; centroid pixel if the parcel contains no pixel centre. Texture: modal USDA class at 10 cm.
soil_openlandmap.confidence_reason: Global machine-learning estimate at 250 m from 1950-2018 profiles; not a lab analysis.

warnings.message: Soil values are a 250 m global model estimate, not a laboratory analysis. Farmer-provided soil tests take priority.

soil_openlandmap.licence: CC-BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike applies to redistributed derived layers)

crop_type.method: Pixel-count histogram of the `cropland` band over the parcel per year; top 3 classes.
crop_type.confidence_reason: CDL accuracy varies by crop and state; the farmer must confirm the current rotation.

bare_months.method: Calendar month with NDVI climatology median < 0.25; NDTI >= 0.1 -> likely residue, otherwise likely bare soil.
bare_months.confidence_reason: High = 5+ years with >= 2 valid observations in the month; medium = 3-4; low = fewer. Months with < 3 such years: [2].
gaps: NDTI residue threshold not validated locally
Wet soil after rain can look like residue in NDTI

vulnerability.label: co-occurrence, not causation
vulnerability.method: Growing-season months only (NDVI climatology >= 0.25). NDVI z-score per month and year against the parcel's own climatology; months with z <= -1.0 are flagged when they coincide with more heat days than that month's mean, a monthly P - ET0 deficit (<= its 20th percentile) or a SMAP root-zone anomaly <= -1 std. `value` lists calendar months with at least 2 such co-occurrences.
vulnerability.confidence_reason: Up to 10 years evaluated per month (climatology needs >= 5).
gaps: Low NDVI can also be harvest, fallow or a crop change, not stress
Crop calendar not known; the rotation module must check the growth stage

erosion_index.note: Relative screening index inspired by RUSLE factors; not a soil-loss estimate.
erosion_index.method: Geometric mean of factors scaled 0-1; low < 0.25 <= medium < 0.5 <= high.
erosion_index.confidence_reason: All four factors available; scaling breakpoints are team hypotheses.
gaps: Breakpoints not calibrated against local erosion measurements

data_gaps.reason: IMERG cross-check not included in this version (time budget).
Current rotation not confirmed by farmer.

provenance.ai_assistance: Parts of this backend were generated with AI coding tools (Claude) and reviewed by the team; see README, 'Use of AI tools'. Indicator values come from the cited datasets, not from an AI model.
